notes: One flag per gym is both the badge ledger entry and the unlock for that town's waystone (docs/world-building/NAVIGATION.md).
Badges themselves are items given by each leader's RCT loot table on first defeat; the flag records the defeat, it does not give the badge.
Leader order is Cobbleverse's RCT requiredDefeats chain per series, read from COBBLEVERSE-RCT-DP-v20. Which leader sits in which town is a trainer-design decision still open.

Level caps are computed by RCT per player from the active series (initialLevelCap 20, relativeLevelCap 0 in modpack/config/rctmod-server.toml since 2026-09-24; Cobbleverse ships 5), so chapters carry no level_cap here.

Gym waystone positions are the block tools/place_town.py sets (the lower half): x and z from the town plan in data/placements.json, y the plan's surface + 1 as its placement report records. tests check they agree.

waystone_gate.why: the owner, play test 2026-10-05 (review 89): "turn that off or make it later waystones are blocked". Off: a gym badge still activates its town's waystone, but no waystone is forgotten for want of a badge and a right-click activates one as the Waystones mod does. true restores the badge gate (activate with the flag, forget without it, re-synced after every use)

open_questions.question: Is the hometown waystone given at start (set_by run_start) or earned?
Do waystones exist between gym towns, and if so what unlocks them?

carries_stage.why: the owner, 2026-10-05: 'Playable end to end is the only target that matters now.' docs/world-building/CRITICAL_PATH_WALK_2.md blocker 2: the reveal moved only by 13 conversations in strict order, so one skipped actor stranded every later one. Winning this badge moves THIS player's stage up to the stage of the beat it closes (data/quests.json main_worldshift_reveal beats[].world_change_flag), never down: tools/progression_pack.py writes flag/<id>/carry, a runmolang on q.player.data() that the flag's granted reward calls once, as the winner. A player who talks to everyone in order is already at or past it, so the carry changes nothing for them. The dialogue's own badge rules (data/quests.json carry_by_* transitions) cover a player who won the badge before this shipped, since a held advancement never re-runs its reward.
carries_stage.requires_tag_why: the starter gate (tools/compile_dialogue.py STARTER_TAG; tools/oak_starter_audit.py P1): the main stage never moves for a player Cobblemon has not given a starter. A player who chose before the tag existed is tagged by Oak's offer (openstarterscreen returns 0); until then this carry does nothing and the next actor's own badge rule (data/quests.json carry_by_*) carries them once they are tagged.

The completion of SQ-SUNSET-01 'A Boat for the Outer Sea' (docs/story/SIDEQUESTS.md). Declared 2026-09-30 because four charter ferry lines gate on it and tools/ferries.py fail-closed the whole pack on 'undeclared field None' the moment the docks made those lines live. DECLARED, NOT SET: nothing grants it, so the four charters are shut, which is the safe direction and honest - the quest is story and is Codex's to write. The owner can instead drop the quest_field gate from data/ferries.json and leave the charters on champion_cleared alone, which is a one-line change and their call.

Heaven's Arena tier 1 of 7 (data/arena_trainers.json; the stand is derived/deep_city/plan.json arena.tiers[0]). Declared because tools/route_trainers.py refuses to emit a trainer whose defeat field is not declared here. The field is NOT a gate: the arena authors no gating at all (the owner, 2026-10-01), and the tier is repeatable, so this records that the player has TAKEN the tier once -- the advancement that sets it fires on the first win only -- rather than that they hold it or may pass.

gym_markers.why: NAVIGATION.md section 6, one gym ahead: when gymN_cleared is granted the player is offered a Xaero's waypoint to the next gym, by a chat share they accept with a click. Gym 1's is Oak's to offer at the start: flag oak_sendoff, granted by his send-off (data/quests.json record_oak_sendoff), offers gym1_town. The waypoint points at the middle of the gym building's placed footprint (tools/place_donor.py box). Replaces Cobbleverse's gym maps, which point at naturally generated gyms this world does not have.
gym_markers.share_format: xaero-waypoint:<name>:<initials>:<x>:<y or ~>:<z>:<color>:<rotation>:<yaw>:Internal-overworld-waypoints, read from xaerominimap-fabric-1.21.1-26.4.2 WaypointSharingHandler (name 1-32 characters, initials 1-3, no '-', '_' or ':')

rift_surveyor.name: Rift Surveyor
rift_surveyor.hint: Victory Road starts at the Rift trailhead, about a thousand blocks north of Holdfast up the Victory Road signs. The Rift surveyor at its gate knows what the Compact is doing in the Rift.
rift_surveyor.why: the Earth Badge's marker (flags gym8_cleared offers_marker_why): the next story actor, at his seat in data/npc_seats.json. Measured 2026-10-06: the seat (3552, 112, 5334) is 1,082 blocks north of Giovanni's spawner (3565, 120, 6416); the Victory Road signposts from Holdfast's exit (3597, 112, 6420) run past him (victory_road_transition_4 at (3561, 113, 5308)). The hint is a system line, not a character's: Codex owns the surveyor's words

league.name: Pokemon League
league.hint: Hoopa is free, and the League's precinct gate on the Deep's north rim will let you through. Victory Road's caves also climb to the League from the Deep's floor, under its north face.

upstream_neutralised.why: Overrides at the upstream paths, deliberately (.claude/rules/datapacks.md). The four loot tables are exploration maps to Cobbleverse's naturally generated gyms, which this world does not generate: cobbleverse:gym_map is the reward of Cobbleverse's cobblemon:craft_pokedex (the first Pokedex a player holds), and the Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh ones reward the previous region's Champion. They become empty. The reward functions are named by Cobbleverse's leader, Elite Four and Champion advancements (cobbleverse:trainer/*/defeat_*) and exist in no installed pack (checked 2026-09-21 across every pack and jar on the server); an empty function of each name means the advancement grants cleanly.

first_win_rewards.why: The owner, 2026-09-24: a leader's rewards are given once, on the first win, to the winner. Upstream they drop from the trainer's rctmod loot table on every win, as items on the ground: the badge (and Brock's badge box) guarded by rctmod:defeat_count == 1, the TM pool not guarded at all, and rctmod never refuses a persistent trainer's rematch, so on staging a second win over Brock dropped TM Rock Slide and paid again (docs/STATE.md). Here each leader's loot table is empty and the flag's one-time reward runs `loot give @s loot cobblers:first_win/<trainer>`: `items` each once, and one of `one_of` (duplicates kept, as upstream weighted them). Read from COBBLEVERSE-RCT-DP-v20, 2026-09-24. CobbleDollars still pays per win (earnCobbleDollarsFromNPC); not changed here.
